verdict.rationale: The evidence pack only cites paid Google One storage tiers (100GB, 2TB) and API documentation, but contains no citation confirming a free tier quota (e.g., the commonly known 15GB) or that the free tier works identically with the same API/clients as paid tiers. Community comments discuss paid pricing comparisons, not a free tier. Missing for 10: explicit free-tier storage quota documentation, confirmation that API/client parity exists for free accounts, and any first-party or community evidence describing the free plan specifically.
